_comment: How the data plane holds a narrowed copy of a capability's Biscuit, which the server and both SDKs' fakes are held to: each case is one capability, issued to the fake's tenant with the audience, ops and prefixes named (audience ["data"] and ops ["get", "manage"] when none are), its Biscuit narrowed by each block of attenuations in turn — ops, resource_prefixes and planes as paladin.Attenuate takes them, expires_in_seconds an expiry that many seconds from now — and the copy presented to the calls in order, each with the answer it gets, none when it succeeds. The calls and placeholders are capability_refusals.json's; {collection} is the prefix of the fake's default collection, object://<tenant>/default/. Codes are Connect's, reasons the ErrorInfo's.

cases.name: a resource outside the copy's prefixes

calls.message: invalid Biscuit attenuation: block 1: child wider than parent: child op "delete" not in parent ops [get]
invalid Biscuit attenuation: block 1: child wider than parent: child prefix "{elsewhere}" not under any parent prefix [{collection}]
invalid Biscuit attenuation: block 1: child wider than parent: audience [data admin] widens parent [data]

cases.name: a later block widening an earlier one

calls.message: invalid Biscuit attenuation: block 2: child wider than parent: child op "manage" not in parent ops [get]
